fill.about: White and Wood's mission is to share and instill our love of food and wine with every guest, while delivering a superior guest and dining experience that is reflective of the rich diversity of the community. White and Wood is based on the guiding principles that life is to be enjoyed and there is no better way to do that than with great food, drink, and company that can be shared in an amazing environment.
